nodes.description: uint256 private maxColor = 2**24, upper bound of valid color token IDs
uint private lastTokenId, seed/state of the pseudo-random LCG token id generator
uint256 public publicPrice = 0.01 ether, price required to call mintHex
bytes alphabet = "0123456789ABCDEF", hex digit table used to build alphabetMap
mapping(bytes1 => uint) alphabetMap, maps each hex character to its numeric value
Color constructor: sets ERC721 name/symbol, initializes lastTokenId to 0 and fills alphabetMap
mintHex(string) external payable: requires publicPrice <= msg.value, parses hex string and mints the resulting token
mint() external: generates pseudo-random token ids via nextTokenId until an unused id is found, then claims it
ownerClaim(uint256) public nonReentrant onlyOwner: mints a specific token id to the owner after bounds check
tokenURI(uint256) public pure override: builds an on-chain SVG/base64 metadata data URI for a token
hexToDec(string) internal view: converts a 6-character hex string into a uint256 using alphabetMap
claimById(uint256) internal nonReentrant: bounds-checks the id and _safeMints it to _msgSender()
nextTokenId() internal: linear congruential generator updating lastTokenId and returning it
msg.sender exposed via Context._msgSender(), used as mint recipient and for owner checks
_safeMint(_msgSender(), tokenId) inside claimById: external onERC721Received callback to an attacker-controlled recipient
unchecked accumulating arithmetic res += alphabetMap[strBytes[i]] << (4*(5-i)) in hexToDec
LCG arithmetic lastTokenId = (a * lastTokenId + c) % m in nextTokenId
_safeMint(owner(), tokenId) inside ownerClaim: external onERC721Received callback performed before returning
string hexStr parameter of mintHex, attacker-supplied hex color string
uint256 tokenId local in mintHex holding the decoded color id
uint256 tokenId local in mint holding the generated unused token id
uint256 tokenId parameter of ownerClaim selecting the id to mint
uint256 tokenId parameter of tokenURI identifying the token metadata
string hexStr parameter of hexToDec, the raw hex string to decode
uint256 tokenId parameter of claimById bounds-checked against maxColor
uint i loop counter in hexToDec iterating over the 6 hex characters
uint256 res accumulator in hexToDec holding the decoded color value
bytes memory strBytes = bytes(hexStr) conversion local in hexToDec

edges.reason: mintHex calls hexToDec to convert the attacker-supplied hex string into a decimal token id
mintHex calls claimById to mint the parsed token id
mint calls nextTokenId to generate the next pseudo-random token id
mint calls claimById to mint the generated token id
claimById executes _safeMint which invokes onERC721Received on the receiving contract, allowing reentrant callbacks before completion
ownerClaim executes _safeMint which invokes onERC721Received on the owner/receiver, allowing reentrant callbacks
msg.sender (via _msgSender) is used as the recipient argument of _safeMint inside claimById
the onlyOwner modifier on ownerClaim requires owner() == _msgSender(), an authorization check on the caller
hexToDec reads alphabetMap to translate each hex character into its numeric value
hexToDec performs shift/add accumulation into res that depends on caller-controlled input
nextTokenId performs LCG arithmetic (a * lastTokenId + c) % m
nextTokenId writes the computed LCG value back into the lastTokenId state variable
nextTokenId reads lastTokenId as the seed of the LCG computation
the constructor populates alphabetMap from the alphabet table
the constructor initializes lastTokenId to 0
the constructor reads the alphabet constant to build alphabetMap
mintHex reads publicPrice to require that msg.value covers the mint price
claimById validates the token id against the maxColor bound
ownerClaim validates the token id against the maxColor bound
the attacker-supplied hexStr parameter is consumed by mintHex and forwarded to hexToDec
the tokenId parameter is consumed by ownerClaim for the bounds check and minting
the tokenId parameter is consumed by tokenURI to render metadata
the hexStr parameter is consumed by hexToDec and indexed without a length check
the tokenId parameter is consumed by claimById for the bounds check and _safeMint
the tokenId decoded in mintHex is passed into claimById
the tokenId generated in mint is passed into claimById
the loop counter i drives the shift arithmetic in hexToDec
the res accumulator is the target of the arithmetic in hexToDec
strBytes derived from hexStr provides the indexed operands of the arithmetic in hexToDec

normalization_plan.reason: hexStr is the input parameter of mintHex and has no independent identity outside it
tokenId is a temporary local holding the decoded value inside mintHex
tokenId is a temporary local holding the generated id inside mint
tokenId is the input parameter of ownerClaim and is fully consumed by it
tokenId is the input parameter of tokenURI and is fully consumed by it
hexStr is the input parameter of hexToDec and is only used to derive strBytes
tokenId is the input parameter of claimById and is only used for its bounds check and mint
i is the loop counter local of hexToDec and has no meaning outside the loop
res is the accumulator local of hexToDec returned to the caller
strBytes is a pure type-cast local of hexToDec derived from its parameter
